subject: Culture
title: Jerusalem's Layers
description: A quick, practical guide to Jerusalem's Layers.

hook.text: Jerusalem is sacred to three religions, besieged 23 times, captured 44 times, and destroyed twice.

buildup.text: Jews pray at the Western Wall. Muslims worship at Al-Aqsa Mosque. Christians venerate the Church of the Holy Sepulchre.

discovery.text: All three sites share a single hilltop. Moving one stone can trigger an international crisis.

twist.text: A Muslim family has held keys to the Church of the Holy Sepulchre since 1187—to stop Christian factions from fighting.

climax.text: Jerusalem's 'status quo' agreement freezes every stone, ladder, and window in place. Change nothing and nobody riots.

punchline.text: Peace sometimes means agreeing to never touch anything.

quiz.question: How many times has Jerusalem been besieged?
